item.title: Master Your Career Storytelling 🎤 • List key roles you've held in your career. • Identify 3 common skills/themes across roles. • Write a summary linking these skills/themes. • Use: “I leveraged X to achieve Y across roles.” • Practice telling this story in 2 minutes. How can you make your career story resonate with your next employer? #career #storytelling #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
